Sjællands Universitetshospital is a Danish university hospital named in both the 2023 and 2024 annual reports of the Database for Atrieflimren i Danmark (AFDK), a national quality-development database for atrial fibrillation treatment run under the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP)[^src1][^src2]. It is mentioned in the corpus specifically as the workplace of [[ole-dyg-pedersen|Ole Dyg Pedersen]], a member of the AFDK steering committee, who holds the title Overlæge (senior consultant) there[^src1][^src2].

The hospital appears in the AFDK 2023 report, which covers the period 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023 and describes, among other things, the composition of the database's steering committee as part of its chapters on data foundations, patient-population definitions, data-collection limitations, and regional atrial fibrillation epidemiology across Denmark's five regions[^src1]. It appears again in the AFDK 2024 report, covering 1 July 2023 to 30 June 2024, which for the first time incorporates data from practising cardiologists reporting to the database since 1 June 2023, and which evaluates atrial fibrillation care quality across 22,073 incident patients and 136,420 prevalent patients using eight main indicators[^src2].

No further descriptive detail about the hospital itself — its location, size, or organizational structure — is provided in the extracted material; its role in the corpus is limited to being the institutional affiliation of Ole Dyg Pedersen.
